comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
I know one place for sure that this can appear is by the Diagonal Boulder in the southeast corner of the map. As expected, NPC mobs were very close to the target area.

This was a lot easier to hunt for with my inventory at 50/50 by taking a few things out of my captain's bag. With my inventory maxed, the game cancelled Search automatically after the first use, so I didn't have to keep cancelling it myself to move on to another place. When I finally found a golden pillar, I just stored the items, and searched on the pillar. Boom! Instant amulet.
